_meanings:
.²1 A multitude, group.
.²2 A pimple or eruption on the face.
.²3 A veranda.
.²4 A heap of grass.
.²5 The string of a fish-hook.
.²6 Pocket.
.²7 The middle part of the sacrificial altar ({#vedI#}); see {#varaRqaka#}.
 (The word {#varaRqalambuka#} in {#yadidAnImahaM varaRqalambuka iva dUramutkzipya#}
 {#pAtitaH#} <ls>Mk. 1</ls> is of doubtful meaning; it seems to mean ‘an over-hanging
 or projecting wall’, which, if raised high, is sure to topple down; so
 in the case of the Sūtradhāra whose expectations were raised very high
 only to be cruelly disappointed. {#varaRqa#} may mean a contrivance for
 drawing water from a well (named {#AkatI#} in Marathi) and {#lambuka#}
 is its handle.)
